newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-INSIGHT - AUSTRALIAN Gold index seen sideways to down.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-INSIGHT - AUSTRALIAN Gold index seen sideways to down.

text.p: The Australian Stock Exchange's gold index (Thursday close: 1,923.8) has fallen from its consolidation pattern and technical indicators say it could reach 1,874 before bouncing.
Only a break above 1,940 is seen stopping the bears.
Short term leading indicators are oversold and turning sideways. The 1,915 level is an important support on the medium term charts and the short term Bollinger bands.
Traders are therefore seen having the luxury of the two breakouts of 1,915 and 1,940 to set their trading strategies.
Looking at the Fibonacci retracements, in the short term, if 1,915 holds, then the short term bulls could be targeting higher levels of 1,950, 1,960 and 1,970.
On the other hand in the medium term, the first lower retracement level is 1,916, with 1,886 and 1,863 to follow.
Hence medium term bears are unlikely to change their strategy unless 2,005 breaks.
While there are some conflicting bullish flag formations and decending wedges still evident, with the index below 1,940, these will be largely ignored.
The index in the medium term has continued to move sideways since the double top at 2,005.
Traders will be using the same levels as in the short term, 1,915, 1,940 and 2,005.
Medium term technicals are mixed to bearish.
With only the ROC still advancing, both the RSI and Stochastic are looking to be turning over and heading lower.
Traders are still likely to adopt a cautious bearish strategy. The longer term chart pattern remains neutral, but the technicals are pointing to lower levels.
All indicators are pointing lower.
Like the shorter term indicators, 2,005 is seen a key level.
With the failure to rally through 2,005 and the subsequent failure of 1,935 as support, traders are likely to trade from the short side.
While some bullish patterns exist, the only real bullish impetus is that in the short term the index is becoming oversold.
Traders are seen targetting key the strategic levels of 1,915, 1,940 and 2,005 to initiate further trades.
(Daniel Fock is a member of the Australian Technical Analysts Association. Views are his own and not those of Reuters.)
